description.cs: Zasáhni dřív, než je nemoc vidět.
description.en: Act before the illness becomes visible.

description.cs: Sepiš pravidla osady a nech je schválit.
description.en: Write the settlement's rules and have them agreed.

description.cs: Postarej se o ty, na které se zapomnělo.
description.en: Look after those who were forgotten.

description.cs: Nech dozrát to, co chceš sníst hned.
description.en: Let ripen what you want to eat now.

description.cs: Pečuj o něco třicet dní bez viditelného výsledku.
description.en: Tend something for thirty days without visible result.

description.cs: Ochraň hodnotu, která ještě není tvoje.
description.en: Guard a value that is not yet yours.

description.cs: Nezasahuj, i když víš, jak to udělat.
description.en: Do not intervene even when you know how.
Leave when the work is done.

description.cs: Jdi bez mapy a bez plánu.
description.en: Walk without a map or a plan.

description.cs: Dodrž, co jsi řekl, i když se to změní.
description.en: Keep what you said even when things change.
Explain one thing to one person.

description.cs: Zapiš každý den jeden dobrý skutek.
description.en: Record one good deed each day.

description.cs: Uzavři dohodu, která nezvýhodní jen tebe.
description.en: Close an agreement that does not favour only you.
Abandon no one in trouble.
Settle a market dispute fairly.
Light a road you will not walk yourself.
Bring a ship home through fog.

description.cs: Pomoz v nejhorším počasí, ne po něm.
description.en: Help in the worst weather, not after it.
Rise differently than you fell.

description.cs: Vrať se tam, odkud tě vyhodili.
description.en: Return where you were thrown out.
Carry the consequences of your return.
Walk instead of leaping.
Go around an obstacle that cannot be broken.

description.cs: Vrať se pokornější, než jsi odešel.
description.en: Return humbler than you left.
Channel pressure so it does not burst the system.

description.cs: Vydrž u jedné práce, dokud není hotová.
description.en: Stay with one job until it is finished.

description.cs: Projdi kolem svého domu a nevejdi.
description.en: Pass your own house and do not go in.
Announce the fault you found.

description.cs: Prošetři bez hněvu a bez spěchu.
description.en: Investigate without anger or haste.
Repair what you announced.
Waste not a single grain.

description.cs: Rozděl úrodu dřív, než se zkazí.
description.en: Share the harvest before it spoils.
Return to the soil what you took.

description.cs: Vrať pobřeží, co mu bylo vzato.
description.en: Return to the shore what was taken from it.
Guard what belongs to everyone.
Take no more than you can carry.
Sit with both sides at once.
Say the uncomfortable thing out loud.

description.cs: Najdi jednu větu, se kterou odejdou oba.
description.en: Find one sentence both can leave with.
Explain a complex decision in human words.

description.cs: Napiš návod, kterému se rozumí bez tebe.
description.en: Write instructions that work without you.
Ask about what you did not understand.

description.cs: Uklidni paniku dřív, než se rozšíří.
description.en: Calm panic before it spreads.

description.cs: Vystup proti strachu, ne proti lidem.
description.en: Stand against fear, not against people.

description.cs: Vrať klid místu, kde se hádalo.
description.en: Return calm to a place that was arguing.

description.cs: Dodej pomoc tam, kam se nedá dojet.
description.en: Deliver help where you cannot drive.

description.cs: Nes jen to, co je potřeba.
description.en: Carry only what is needed.

description.cs: Vrať se pro dalšího, ne pro odměnu.
description.en: Come back for the next one, not for the reward.
Bring someone safely through danger.
Fly a route that cannot be walked.

description.cs: Vrať se s tím, koho jsi vzal.
description.en: Come back with the one you took.

description.cs: Odlož titul a jdi mezi lidi.
description.en: Set the title aside and walk among people.
Pass through a place unrecognised.
Show yourself as you are.

description.cs: Řekni své podmínky dřív, než začne práce.
description.en: State your conditions before the work starts.

description.cs: Zastav toho, kdo spěchá přes tvoje hranice.
description.en: Stop whoever rushes past your boundaries.
Say ‘not like this' without explaining.

description.cs: Nech se pozvat, i když to neumíš.
description.en: Let yourself be invited even if you are not good at it.
Rest and explain nothing.

description.cs: Nech si pomoct od někoho, komu jsi pomohl.
description.en: Let someone you helped help you.
Learn the sky without an app.

description.cs: Jdi podle hvězd, ne podle značek.
description.en: Navigate by stars, not by signs.
Teach the sky to someone else.

description.cs: Nech vodu téct tam, kam chce.
description.en: Let the water go where it wants.
Return water to a dry riverbed.

description.cs: Respektuj krajinu i tam, kde nic nevydělá.
description.en: Respect the land even where it earns nothing.
Climb higher so you can see the whole.

description.cs: Najdi, co drží pohromadě a co ne.
description.en: Find what holds together and what does not.
Protect what you saw from above.

description.cs: Nech krajinu mluvit dřív než lidi.
description.en: Let the land speak before people do.
Find a source no one is watching.

description.cs: Nauč jednu věc za měsíc, ne za den.
description.en: Teach one thing in a month, not in a day.

description.cs: Vyčkej správné chvíle, i když to bolí.
description.en: Wait for the right moment even when it hurts.
Prepare everything beforehand, not on the way.

description.cs: Projdi, když je čas, a ne dřív.
description.en: Cross when it is time, and not before.

description.cs: Hledej to, co v obraze chybí.
description.en: Look for what is missing from the picture.

description.cs: Jdi bez lucerny a bez jistoty.
description.en: Walk without a lantern or certainty.

description.cs: Pojmenuj obraz, který vznikl z ničeho.
description.en: Name the shape that came from nothing.
Plant a rule, not just a promise.

description.cs: Napiš, kdo je chráněn a kdo ne.
description.en: Write down who is protected and who is not.
Bring, do not take.

description.cs: Najdi slabé místo dřív než bouře.
description.en: Find the weak point before the storm.

description.cs: Připrav se na výpadek, který přijde.
description.en: Prepare for the outage that is coming.

description.cs: Obnov, co spadlo, a zapiš proč.
description.en: Restore what fell and record why.
Walk without a destination for at least an hour.
Find a trace you cannot see elsewhere.
Do not speak for a day, only listen.
Name the harm, not only the intention.

description.cs: Spoj dvě řeči, které se neposlouchají.
description.en: Join two languages that do not listen to each other.
Close the agreement only after repair.
Restore a place that was exhausted.
Protect what has no substitute.

description.cs: Vrať zemi, co jsi jí vzal.
description.en: Give back to the land what you took.

description.cs: Otevři nebe místu, které se dusí.
description.en: Open the sky over a place that is suffocating.

description.cs: Nech padat, i když to zpozdí cestu.
description.en: Let it fall even if it delays the journey.
Let go of what must go.
Separate so that there may be light.
Plant a tree that outlives you.
Let it grow without interference.
Limit the catch before it disappears.
Let the sea rest for a season.

description.cs: Vrať se, až bude zase co lovit.
description.en: Return when there is something to catch again.
Sow before you settle the disputes.

description.cs: Sdílej úrodu i s tím, kdo nepomáhal.
description.en: Share the harvest even with whoever did not help.

description.cs: Ukonči spor dřív, než přijde o úrodu.
description.en: End the quarrel before the harvest is lost.
Build a defence, not an attack.
Shield the weakest members of the group.
Withdraw in time and without losses.
Test what falls apart.
Check what actually holds.
After the storm, calm what remains.
Take two and leave the third.

description.cs: Nech les růst i po tvém odchodu.
description.en: Leave the forest growing after you go.
Feed someone without emptying the place.
Pass through a change that cannot be undone.
Stay in the dark until it passes.
Return different, not the same.
Find your way home without a signal.
Find north without a compass.
Sail back to where you set out.
Release means that got stuck.

description.cs: Spoj dvě řeky, které tekly odděleně.
description.en: Join two rivers that ran apart.
Share what you have to spare.
Prove the accusation before you strike.
Strike once and precisely.
After the strike, be silent.
Slow a decision to a readable pace.
Calm your head before the meeting.

description.cs: Rozhodni v klidu, ne v tlaku.
description.en: Decide in calm, not under pressure.
Carry away what no longer belongs.
Move a whole elsewhere without breaking it.

description.cs: Usaď se jinde a nezůstávej stát.
description.en: Settle elsewhere and do not stall.

description.cs: Mluv první a nech druhého odpovědět.
description.en: Speak first and let the other answer.
Let the other speak and listen.
Take turns without interrupting.
Say it in one sentence.
Do not speak until you must.
Say only what you can carry.

description.cs: Propoj dvě věci, které spolu nesouvisí.
description.en: Link two things that do not seem connected.
Tell a rule as a story instead of a sermon.
Let the listener finish the point.
Take apart what does not work.
Put it together differently, not the same.
Return the whole to service.
Weigh words against deeds.
Admit what is heavy.

description.cs: Řekni to nahlas i s důsledky.
description.en: Say it aloud with the consequences.

description.cs: Jednej bez převahy, i když ji máš.
description.en: Negotiate without the upper hand even if you have it.

description.cs: Nenech druhého ponížit ani zvítězit nad ním.
description.en: Do not let the other be humiliated or beaten down.
Close a peace that lasts.
